description: Schedule and publish video and image posts to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and X from one place. Connect an account once, upload a file, and schedule it to several destinations at a chosen time; ViewPrinter handles each platform's upload and reports what happened per destination. It also reads back views, likes and follower counts for what has been published, so performance can be asked about in the same conversation the post was made in.
